basic_details.job_title: JKPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 70 Posts
basic_details.job_location: Government Colleges under Higher Education Department, J&K
basic_details.short_information: The Jammu and Kashmir Public Service Commission (JKPSC) has invited online applications for filling up 70 backlog vacancies of Assistant Professor across 24 disciplines in Government Colleges under the Higher Education Department (HED), Jammu & Kashmir, vide Notification No. 06-PSC(DR-P) of 2026 dated 31 July 2026. Only domiciles of the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir possessing the prescribed academic/professional qualification and age are eligible to apply. The application form will be available on the JKPSC website from 1 August 2026, and the last date to complete the online application,

application_fee.details: The requisite fee must be deposited through online mode after successful submission of the online application form. Applications submitted without fee deposition will be treated as incomplete and rejected without notice.

Candidates must also have cleared NET conducted by UGC/CSIR, or an equivalent test accredited by UGC such as SLET/SET, OR hold a PhD degree awarded in accordance with UGC (Minimum Standards and Procedures for Award of M.Phil/PhD Degree) Regulations 2009 or 2016 (subject to specified conditions such as evaluation by two external examiners, an open PhD viva voce, and publication/presentation of research papers). Candidates seeking consideration under a reserved category must possess a valid requisite category certificate on the cut-off date; false or fraudulent certificate claims will lead to debarment from JKPSC examinations.

how_to_apply: Candidates can apply for the JKPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 by following these steps:
Visit the official JKPSC website: www.jkpsc.nic.in.
Complete or update your One Time Registration (OTR) if not already done, filling personal information, contact details, and educational qualification.
Upload a date-stamped recent passport-size colour photograph (not taken before 01.01.2026) and signature, sized between 10 KB and 20 KB in JPEG/JPG format.
Log in and click on "Show Examination" against the relevant post/examination.
Select the advertisement notification month, then click "Apply" against the post for which you are eligible.
Read the instructions carefully, then click "Apply" and fill in the remaining required fields.
Review all details for correctness, then click "Submit" to push the data to the server.
Pay the requisite application fee online through the "Submitted Applications" menu in your account.
Upload all mandatory and category-specific documents.
Download and retain a printout of the submitted application form for future reference.

Applications must be submitted only through the official JKPSC website; no other mode of application will be accepted. Candidates are advised to apply well before the closing date of 31 August 2026 to avoid last-minute technical issues.
important_instructions: Only domiciles of the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir are eligible to apply, and a valid Domicile Certificate must be uploaded; certificates issued after the last date for submission of the application will not be entertained. The last date for receipt of online applications will be the cut-off date for determining eligibility related to acquisition of educational/professional qualification or any certificate on the basis of which reservation is claimed, notwithstanding any extension of the submission deadline. Candidates who have successfully submitted the online application along with the requisite fee will be allowed to edit some fields between 01.09.2026 and 03.09.2026; detailed instructions will be made available separately on the website. Candidates will not be required to submit a hard copy of the application or documents to the Commission, but must present a downloaded copy of the online application form along with original certificates at the time of document verification. Candidates found guilty of misconduct - including impersonation, submitting fabricated documents, making false statements, or using unfair means - may be disqualified and debarred from JKPSC examinations, either permanently or for a specified period, and may face disciplinary action if already in government service. For securing entry into the examination centre, candidates must carry the Admit Card/Roll Number Slip, at least two recent passport-size colour photographs (not taken before 01.01.2026), and a valid original photo ID such as Aadhaar Card, Voter's ID, Driving License, PAN Card, Passport, or College/University ID Card. Once a candidate is allotted an examination centre (Srinagar or Jammu), requests for a change of centre will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: JKPSC Assistant Professor Vacancy 2026: Discipline-wise Details
content_sections.text: The 70 backlog vacancies (1st Special Drive, from Notification No. 06-PSC(DR-P) of 2023 & 17-PSC(DR-P) of 2023) are distributed across the following disciplines, with category-wise breakup: Category abbreviations used: OM = Open Merit, SC = Scheduled Caste, ST = Scheduled Tribe, ALC/IB = Actual Line of Control/International Border, PSP = Persons Settled in Pakistan, EWS = Economically Weaker Section.

content_sections.heading: JKPSC Assistant Professor Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the JKPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 must be domiciles of the UT of Jammu & Kashmir and must meet the prescribed educational qualification and age limit detailed below. For most disciplines, candidates must fulfil either of the following: Option A: A Master's Degree with 55% marks (50% for SC/ST/Differently Abled/PhD degree holders who obtained their Master's Degree prior to 19 September 1991), or an equivalent grade on a point scale, in the concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Candidates must also have cleared NET conducted by UGC/CSIR, or an equivalent test accredited by UGC such as SLET/SET, OR hold a PhD degree awarded in accordance with UGC (Minimum Standards and Procedures for Award of M.Phil/PhD Degree) Regulations 2009 or 2016 (subject to specified conditions such as evaluation by two external examiners, an open PhD viva voce, and publication/presentation of research papers). NET/SLET/SET is not required for disciplines in which it is not conducted by UGC/CSIR or similar accredited bodies. Option B: A PhD Degree obtained from a foreign university/institution ranked among the top 500 in the world by QS World University Rankings, The Times Higher Education (THE), or the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) by Shanghai Jiao Tong University. For the Music discipline specifically, candidates may alternatively qualify as a traditional and professional artist with commendable achievement in the subject, who has studied under noted/reputed traditional masters, holds "A" grade Artist status of AIR/Doordarshan, and has the ability to teach theory with illustrations in the discipline concerned. Age is reckoned as on 1 January 2026. Candidates seeking consideration under a reserved category must possess a valid requisite category certificate on the cut-off date; false or fraudulent certificate claims will lead to debarment from JKPSC examinations.

content_sections.heading: JKPSC Assistant Professor Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be appointed in the Pay Band of ₹15,600–39,100 with Academic Grade Pay (AGP) of ₹6,000 (Pre-revised), equivalent to ₹57,000 in Level-10 of the applicable pay matrix.

content_sections.heading: JKPSC Assistant Professor Application Fee
content_sections.text: The requisite fee must be deposited through online mode after successful submission of the online application form. Applications submitted without fee deposition will be treated as incomplete and rejected without notice.

content_sections.heading: JKPSC Assistant Professor Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for the JKPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 will be made in terms of Rule 45 of the J&K Public Service Commission (Business & Procedure) Rules, 2021, as amended up to date. The process includes: A written examination consisting of a single paper of 3 hours' duration, carrying 120 multiple choice questions. The syllabus is available on the official JKPSC website. The written examination will be held at Srinagar and Jammu centres, as opted by the candidate; centre allotment is at the sole discretion of the Commission. Admit cards will be available for download about two weeks before the examination date on jkpsc.nic.in. Document verification will follow, where candidates must produce original certificates supporting all claims made in the application, including educational qualification, age, category, and domicile. The JKPSC will not undertake detailed scrutiny of applications at the time of the written examination; candidature will be accepted only provisionally, and claims not substantiated by proof at the verification stage will lead to cancellation of candidature.

content_sections.heading: Required Documents
content_sections.text: While filling the online application, candidates are required to upload the following documents: Date of Birth Certificate (Secondary School/Matric Certificate) Domicile Certificate of the UT of J&K Graduation Degree PG (Postgraduate) Degree NET/SET/SLET/PhD certificate (any one) Category Certificate Disability Certificate (for PwD candidates) In-service certificate signed by HOD (for in-service candidates) M.Phil certificate along with result notification PhD notification JRF/NET/SET/SLET certificate Experience certificates (as per prescribed format, up to 5 leaves) List of books published as 1st/2nd author Gold Medal certificate for overall first position in the prescribed qualification National/State/Institution Award certificate List of research papers as I/II or corresponding author, as per format Post Doctorate certificate (minimum 1 year) No further opportunity to upload documents will be provided after the cut-off date, and applications without the mandatory documents may be rejected.

faq.question: Q1. What is JKPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Jammu and Kashmir Public Service Commission (JKPSC) to fill 70 backlog vacancies of Assistant Professor across 24 disciplines in Government Colleges under the Higher Education Department, J&K.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in JKPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 70 backlog vacancies are available across 24 disciplines, with Political Science carrying the highest number at 23 posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for JKPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to complete the online application, including fee payment and document upload, is 31 August 2026. The application form is available from 1 August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for JKPSC Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Candidates generally need a Master's Degree with 55% marks (50% for SC/ST/Differently Abled/pre-1991 PhD holders) in the relevant subject, along with NET/SLET/SET, or a PhD as per UGC regulations (with certain exemption conditions). Full discipline-specific qualification details are given in the qualification section above.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for JKPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: As on 1 January 2026, the age limit is 40 years for Open Merit and in-service/government candidates, 43 years for reserved categories, and 42 years for Physically Challenged candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for JKPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹1,200 for General category candidates, ₹700 for Reserved category candidates, and Nil for PHC (Physically Handicapped) candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for JKPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through www.jkpsc.nic.in after completing One Time Registration (OTR), between 1 August 2026 and 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for JKPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is made as per Rule 45 of the JKPSC (Business & Procedure) Rules, 2021, comprising a written examination of 120 multiple choice questions in a single 3-hour paper, followed by document verification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for JKPSC Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be placed in the Pay Band of ₹15,600–39,100 with AGP of ₹6,000 (Pre-revised), equivalent to ₹57,000 in Level-10.

faq.question: Q10. Is domicile required for JKPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Only candidates possessing a valid Domicile Certificate of the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir, issued by the competent authority in the prescribed format, are eligible to apply.
